evidence.note: Title '12 and 14 Cross-town fell 14 and 11 points while the network fell 5' matches punctuality.md (-14.2, -11.1; network 86.2% -> 81.0%).
Bar labels 86/81, 85/70, 85/74, 87/87 and Target 90% round the dashboard figures in punctuality.md correctly.
'the other six routes held' matches the source's 'each within +/-2 points of Q2'.

'Routes 12 and 14 Cross-town account for almost all of the network's fall' is not stated by any source; with eight routes, two falling ~14 and ~11 points account for roughly 3 of the 5.2-point network fall at equal weights, and route weights are not given, while the other six could each move up to 2 points.

rationale: Figures, rounding, target and the 'other six held' claim are faithful to punctuality.md. But the step-3 Insight attributes 'almost all' of the network fall to routes 12 and 14, a decomposition the source never makes and its figures do not support without departure weights. That states as certain a scope the source does not back, matching the fail descriptor.
